summary: Frontend-only testing of /standalone.html and /standalone_offline.html per iteration 7 request. Verified: (1) password lock overlay and 'Blocca' button fully removed, (2) Html5Qrcode library inlined successfully (window.__Html5QrcodeLibrary__.Html5Qrcode exposed as function), (3) PDF upload of /tmp/sample.pdf correctly generates 4 notes for WR 17017162, 17414109, 17443542, 17439540, (4) each note action row has buttons in exact order: 'Copia nota', 'Invia tramite Gmail', 'Scansiona seriale', 'Modifica campi', 'Elimina', (5) scanner modal (#scannerModal) opens with picker (#scannerPicker visible, #scannerReader hidden) and two .scan-target-btn with data-target='cpe' and 'ont_sfp' plus titles 'CPE' / 'ONT / SFP', (6) clicking CPE target hides picker and shows reader, sets #scannerTargetLbl='CPE'. In Playwright headless, Chromium's fake camera actually starts (Html5Qrcode.start does NOT reject) so the toast error path is not exercised — but the flow succeeds without any pageerror. Camera video element is visible. (7) #scannerClose closes modal and resets. (8) Photo buttons 'Scatta foto' + 'Galleria' still present per note. (9) /standalone_offline.html (2.6MB) loads over HTTPS, has same behavior — no lockScreen, no Blocca, scannerModal present, 4 WRs parsed, 4 Scansiona seriale buttons. No console pageerror on either file.
critical_code_review_comments: standalone.html is ~415KB and standalone_offline.html is ~2.6MB (pdf.js + html5-qrcode inlined). Acceptable for offline distribution but note the size.
Overlay-click close handler compares e.target.id === 'scannerModal' — works only when clicking the exact overlay div, not children; verified via direct .click() on the modal element.

Html5Qrcode.start does not reject in Chromium headless because a fake camera is provided; the graceful 'Impossibile avviare la fotocamera' toast path cannot be exercised in this environment but the code path is present in source and looks correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Standalone HTML files are self-contained. Test by loading REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/standalone.html directly with Playwright, uploading /tmp/sample.pdf, and inspecting DOM. In Chromium headless the fake camera makes Html5Qrcode.start succeed; to test the error toast you'd need to disable the fake camera flag or override getUserMedia via page.addInitScript to throw.
